draft.diplomatic_transcription:
Tametſi quorſum tandem attinet,
mei velut vmbram atqꝫ imaginem finitione repræſenta
re , cum ipſam me coram præſentes præſentem oculis
intueamini ? Sum etenim vti videtis , vera illa largitrix
ἐάων, quam Latini ſtulticiam, Græci μωρίαν appellant.

draft.typography_notes: Roman type with Greek. Passage begins mid-line (preceding words on the line: 'genus ita cõſentiat ,'). Lineation as printed; no hyphen at 'repræſenta|re'. 'atqꝫ' = atque with the -que abbreviation sign (ꝫ, U+A76B). æ ligature kept. Space before some commas and before '?' as printed. Initial v in 'vmbram', 'vti'.
